title: The Assistant can act on TJ's behalf in any session: swaps first, then other actions that wait for his typed yes

requirements.text: A session told by the Assistant to swap does so without TJ typing in that pane: genlock swap accepts the yes the Assistant relays, recorded as relayed by the Assistant along with TJ's words
requirements.check: tests/run.mjs: swap with a relayed yes (via assistant) succeeds and its record names the Assistant and TJ's words

requirements.text: Spinoff launch and genlock close accept a relayed yes the same way
requirements.check: tests/run.mjs: spinoff launch and close with a relayed yes succeed, and each record names the relay

requirements.text: A relayed yes is accepted only from the Assistant (its own channel/token), never from any other session
requirements.check: tests/run.mjs: the same flag from a non-Assistant session is refused

requirements.text: The Assistant's instructions say to pass TJ's own words, never invent a yes
requirements.check: file: Assistant rules text contains the relay rule

requirements.text: From the phone, TJ asks Tally to swap a project session and it swaps with no typing in that pane
requirements.check: manual: TJ does it from the phone

text: TJ wants the relayed yes to count as his own approval for swap/close/spinoff launch
breaks: Approval rule loosened on a peer-relayed request; TJ confirms directly before anyone builds it

text: Confirmed by TJ directly: the Assistant acts as TJ across Genlock sessions (spin up, spin down, swap, manage everything), because on the phone he talks only to the Assistant
user_said: yes the assistant needs to work basicallya s me across the genlock sessions, becuase on the phone app, i only talk to the assistant, not the sessions. so the assistant needs to be able to spin up, spin down, swap sessions and manage everything in the 'backend'.
